headline: Ward 41's best and worst numbers share one cause, its edge-of-city location near O'Hare.
summary:
O'Hare sits inside Ward 41's boundary, and that explains the ward's most unusual number. Ride-share spending here comes to $166.7 million a year, measured as trips starting inside the ward, more than twenty-five times what the two lowest-ranked wards report and the highest total in Chicago. A ward built mostly of single-family blocks on the Far Northwest Side does not generate that kind of ride-share volume from its own residents. An international airport's pickup and drop-off line does.

The rest of Ward 41's strongest numbers trace back to the same position at the city's edge. Ground-level spots here get more direct sun than anywhere else in Chicago, true on both the summer and winter solstice, because low-rise houses on the Far Northwest Side do not block the sky the way downtown's towers do. That same distance runs the other direction at the bottom of the list. Ward 41 sits farther from Lake Michigan and from the Loop than any other ward in the city, and public transit use for commuting lands near the very bottom too, each one a different way of measuring how far this ward sits from downtown.
reading_the_rankings: Two of Ward 41's most striking rankings need a second look before they mean what they seem to. Last place for seeing friends weekly is not a headcount of anyone in the ward. It is a demographic model that assigns Ward 41 the social pattern of similar-looking areas nationwide, and the researchers behind it rate their own estimate low confidence, so the number reflects a national dataset's assumptions about places like this one, not an actual count of how often Ward 41 residents see their friends. The violent crime rate at the top of the list needs the same caution in the other direction. It reads as the lowest of the fifty wards, but that count is divided among wards by each census tract's land area rather than by where people actually live, so a tract straddling Ward 41 and a neighboring ward can hand some of the neighbor's crime total to Ward 41's side, or the reverse. The rate is still a real signal that reported violence runs low here, though the census-tract math behind it leaves room for error at the boundary.

news.headline: After 4 Deaths At Norwood Park Metra Crossing, Safety Improvements Underway
news.note: Union Pacific began installing a four-quadrant gate system at the Nagle Avenue Metra crossing in Norwood Park, the site of four deaths and 12 collisions since 2010.
